faqs.question: Do I need attestation for Dubai visit?
faqs.answer: Often not a full employment chain — depends on purpose. Ask before paying stamps.

body:

Evidence standard before you spend

For anything related to document, attestation, dubai, keep proofs that a third party can verify: offers on letterhead, bank PDFs with history, attestation receipts, and language results that match the program. Screenshots without context are not a file. If a seller asks you to hide a refusal, change the topic — that is not how SK Immigration works.

  • Offer/contract names match the passport spelling
  • Language rule is printed (IELTS score, MOI, German level, etc.)
  • Funds story matches 3–6 months of statements where missions care about history
  • Attestation order is destination-correct (Apostille vs MOFA paths are not toys)
  • Official mission or university pages were opened the same week you pay

Mistakes we see on “document attestation dubai uae” files

  • Treating “document attestation dubai uae” as a slogan instead of a document checklist
  • Transferring deposits before CUIN and written fee scope are confirmed
  • Copy-pasting another student’s SOP or bank story
  • Hiring anyone who sells a guaranteed visa outcome
